headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 26, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a crucial 2-1 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Michael Busch leading the offense with a home run and an RBI. In other news, the Baltimore Orioles snapped the Tampa Bay Rays' winning streak with a 7-9 victory, while the Minnesota Twins fell short in Chicago with a 1-3 decision to the White Sox.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Luis Robert Jr. of the New York Mets, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a lumbar spine disc herniation. Other injured players include Aaron Civale of the Athletics, Denzel Clarke of the Athletics, Noah Schultz of the White Sox, Logan Henderson of the Brewers, Jesse Scholtens of the Rays, Tyrone Taylor of the Mets, and Jose Quintana of the Rockies.

The Colorado Rockies made a roster move ahead of their series, trading left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals in exchange for cash. The Rockies also acquired right-handed pitcher Andrew Baker from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for future considerations and international bonus pool money.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cubs in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Chicago Cubs 2-1, securing a crucial win in the matchup. Michael Busch led the Pirates' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Ben Brown pitched a strong 6.0 innings for the Cubs.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Orioles in Thrilling 7-9 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-9 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Jonathan Aranda led the Rays' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Shane McClanahan pitched 5.1 strong innings for the Rays.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins dropped a 1-3 decision to the Chicago White Sox, failing to secure a win. Drew Romo led the Twins' offense with a home run and two RBIs, while Anthony Kay earned the win with six strong innings.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Brewers 5-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 5-1 loss to the Milwaukee Brewers in their latest matchup. Christian Yelich led the Brewers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Luis Robert Jr. Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: New York Mets center fielder Luis Robert Jr. has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a lumbar spine disc herniation.

top_news.title: **Rockies Make Roster Move Ahead of Series**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals in exchange for cash on May 25, 2026.
